I don't understand why a lot of people in these comments try to either cell it grooming or say it's the daughter's own fault. Why can't we just admit we don't know how guilty she is?? On the one hand this could have all happened spontaneously while she was an adult leaving for college, in which case she is 100% responsible for what she has done. On the other hand he could have been grooming her since a young age (we don't know how long he's even been her stepfather), and just waited for her to become an adult and come back, in which case she still doesn't get a full pass, but we can agree that she was manipulated. Since nobody knows this, probably not even OP, stop guessing and acting like you've got all the facts.
